name: The Old Stone
title: The eldest Knapper; remembers the agreement

profile.personality: Very slow. Speaks for all Knappers and apologises to none of them. Listens through the floor.
profile.history: Was young when the builders asked the Knappers to make the ways. Remembers the Quiet as the day the walkers stopped answering.
profile.goals: Hear the agreement kept. Quiet rock.
profile.fears: Noise without meaning. Being asked for something and then forgotten again.
profile.contradiction: Patient for two hundred years; will not wait one more day for a lie.
profile.problem: The lower ways are collapsed, and only Knappers can open them, and Knappers will not work for walkers who shout.

schedule.why: On the seat the builders carved for it, listening.
At the Heart, which it helped to build.
